description: Pick a chord root and type to see its notes and hear it played.

faqs.a: All 12 roots (C through B) and 8 types: major, minor, 7th, maj7, min7, dim, aug and sus4.
Press the Play chord button to hear every note together, synthesized with Web Audio.
It lists each note by name (for example C – E – G).

howto: Read the notes and press Play chord.
title: Chord Finder
